version: v1.6.0 — Fast Boot + Fast Save Load + Smooth Monthly Tick
name: Geoplanetical Fire Performance Mod
description:
Made this mod for my laptop (8GB RAM / integrated graphics) to get smooth 60 FPS, fast loading, and smooth monthly ticks — works great on all PCs!

WHAT IT DOES:
- FPS Boost (removes heavy textures, 3D clouds/atmosphere, and UI blurs)
- Turbo Speed 3 (>>> runs at ~16 days/sec with smooth daily date counter)
- 5.8x Faster New World Gen (~22s vs 131s: 4GB Heap + C++ zlib + fast validation)
- 3.5x Faster Save Loading (~13s vs 46s: skips forced session-switch autosave + fast restore)
- Smooth Monthly Ticks (2.4x faster CGE world trade + adaptive 16ms UI frame slicing)
- Hotkeys: F10 toggles Fire Graphics, F2 toggles Turbo Speed 3 (F11 untouched)

EASY 1-CLICK INSTALL (NO NODE.JS NEEDED):
Steam Workshop only loads textures by default. Run installer once (uses the game's built-in engine):
1. In Steam, right-click Geoplanetical > Manage > Browse local files.
2. In address bar click 'steamapps', then go to: workshop/content/4137120/3834097787
3. Double-click Install-Mod.bat and wait ~2 seconds until it says Done.
4. Launch the game! You will see 'FIRE [F10] · TURBO [F2]' and FPS in top-right corner.

HOW TO TOGGLE OR UNINSTALL:
- F10: toggle Fire Graphics ON/OFF with on-screen toast.
- F2: toggle Turbo Speed 3 ON/OFF.
- Or turn off in Mods menu, or run Uninstall-Mod.bat to restore.
